dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Low-resolution concave curvature on trailing edge fitting a single-bend spline from base to apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex with minimal rounding radius due to low-poly mesh structure.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Linear segment at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal midline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.4:1 ratio of longitudinal base length to vertical apex height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Large-radius convexity transitioning into a near-linear slope toward the anterior.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: High thickness-to-length ratio, exhibiting a blunt, triangular terminal point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse transition angle of approximately 160 degrees at the junction of the melon and rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Non-biological teal-colored luminescent texture mapping across the dorsal and lateral surfaces of a low-polygon geometric mesh.
